item.title: Homemade Electrolyte Powder
item.description: Larry plays tennis most weekends, and looked into making electrolyte powder to mix into his water bottle. He adapted this electrolyte powder recipe to make a small jar, which lasts him about 10 months when used once a week. It’s a gazillion times cheaper than pre-made powders, and has all the essential contents.

item.title: Garden Smoothie
item.description: It’s blackberry and pear season! After enjoying our friend Judi’s “momba” smoothies so many times, we got a good Ninja blender to make our own. Dr. Gregor has some videos about research that shows you get all the benefits of the kale and berries in blended form, but that’s not true for all fruits. We harvest a lot of blackberries and pears in August, and end up freezing some of the blackberries. In addition to pear & blackberry crisp, it’s a great, healthy way to use up the harvest.
